kmn.title: Know my number
kmn.description: View the phone number linked to this SIM.

section.enter-number-description: The number below is linked to your current account profile.
section.enter-number-other-description: Insert the number you require the PUK code for.
section.error-puk-invalid-mtn-number: Try again with a valid MTN number
section.error-puk-unauthorised-description: You do not have the necessary authorization to retrieve the PUK code for this number. Only the account holder can request this information. If you believe this is an error, please contact customer support.
section.description-error: Please refresh or try again later.
section.success-puk2: We have successfully retrieved your PUK. For your convenience please copy the PUK number below and store it in a safe place.
section.success-puk3: We have successfully retrieved the PUK number. For your convenience please copy the PUK number below and store it in a safe place.
section.hidden-puk: PUK number will be hidden in:
section.copy-puk1: Your PUK number has been copied to the device clipboard.
section.info-puk-description: The PIN Unblocking Key (PUK) is a unique master security code used for unblocking and resetting the Personal Identification Number (PIN) on mobile phones if it is lost or forgotten. This specific code can only be obtained directly from MTN.
section.info-puk-sim-blocked-title: Why does a SIM card get blocked?
section.info-puk-sim-blocked-description: Entering your PIN incorrectly three times automatically blocks your SIM card for security
section.info-puk-when-blocked-description: You can only make emergency calls. All other phone features are restricted.
section.info-puk-unlock-description: Enter your PUK code when prompted to restore full access.
